facts.text: The hotel sits at the base of the Tremblant peaks.
facts.excerpt: Nestled at the base of the majestic Tremblant peaks, Fairmont Tremblant blends relaxation and adventure.

facts.text: Guest rooms have views of the mountain, the pedestrian village or the surrounding woodlands.
facts.excerpt: breathtaking views of the mountain, pedestrian village, or surrounding woodlands

facts.text: The lobby has soaring wooden beams and stone walls, with a fireplace.
facts.excerpt: The grandeur of the soaring wooden beams and impressive stone walls creates an immediate sense of arrival

facts.text: Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel experience at the property.
facts.excerpt: Upgrade to Fairmont Gold for an exclusive hotel-within-a-hotel experience

facts.text: Fairmont Gold includes complimentary breakfast and afternoon canapes.
Many rooms have sofa beds and full kitchens.
facts.excerpt: Many of our hotel rooms offer sofa beds and full kitchens for added convenience.

facts.text: Apres-ski activities include a slope-side hot tub and an outdoor DJ.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy après-ski activities like the slope-side hot tub and outdoor DJ for a perfect alpine experience.

facts.text: The hotel has a Terrasse Apres-Ski for drinks with mountain views.
facts.excerpt: Unwind after a day on the slopes at our Terrasse Après-Ski. Enjoy cozy seating, delicious drinks, and stunning mountain views.

facts.text: The First Tracks program gives guests early access to the slopes before the mountain officially opens.
facts.excerpt: Be the first on the slopes with exclusive early access.

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool terrace with hot, cold and relaxing experiences.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy alpine living with hot, cold, and relaxing outdoor pool terrace experiences.

facts.text: The hotel has a spa called Moment Spa.
Choux Gras Brasserie Culinaire is a restaurant at the hotel offering a three-course table d'hote.
facts.excerpt: a three-course table d'hôte at the renowned Choux Gras Brasserie Culinaire

facts.text: Breakfast is served at Le Comptoir.
facts.excerpt: a delicious breakfast at Le Comptoir

facts.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee

facts.text: The hotel is at 3045 Chemin de la Chapelle in Mont-Tremblant, Quebec.
facts.excerpt: 3045 Chemin de la Chapelle, Mont-Tremblant, Québec J8E 1E1

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists Fairmont Tremblant in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2021 through 2026.
Many rooms are newly renovated with contemporary alpine chic decor.
facts.excerpt: Newly renovated, contemporary alpine chic decor, ideal for a couple or individual
